description: Fixed Minnesota business-credential acquisition with current source-use prerequisites, shared publisher exclusion and durable app evidence; not a business census.
redirect_policy: Fixed URLs only; reject redirects and omit credentials. No caller network, clock, field or budget overrides.
retry: Zero network retries. Wait up to fifteen minutes for the shared local gate with cooperative cancellation; no automatic source reacquisition or interrupted-job restart.
checkpoint: Start before requests, complete notices and schema evidence before CSV, immutable parent acquisition checkpoint before terminal completion. Reuse retained data for downstream promotion.
idempotency: UUID job and receipt history. New acquisition is explicit; no automatic freshness deduplication or overwrite.
cancellation: Cooperative AbortSignal/IPC, complete committed local evidence finalization, retain finished bundles and app history, remove only the owned publisher lock after handover spacing.
retention_profile: Internal selected evidence and publisher notices; local-review normalization. No raw CSV or rejected personal values. Operator-governed deletion.

output_schema_contract.postal_fields: Separate nullable ZIP5/ZIP4; no inferred geography.
output_schema_contract.geocode: Nullable latitude/longitude only; these sources do not establish geocodes or physical premises.
output_schema_contract.claims: Source credentials and Issued status are not verified active establishments, unique business identities or national completeness.
